display_name: From SAP Project Manager to GRC & Security Lead
subtitle: Ten-week bridge programme for directing SAP security, GRC and identity workstreams.
learning_principle: The course develops enough security and GRC depth to direct specialists, challenge evidence, govern risk decisions and lead incidents—without requiring live SAP, GRC or cloud-system access.

files: Security Instructor Guide and Answer Key

assessment: Certification: Module quizzes 15%, Practical 15%, Case reviews 20%, Planning pack 20%, Capstone 30%. Requires 75% overall, at least 70% on every element, capstone ≥70/100, and presentation ≥21/30.

study_model: Read the current security/GRC lesson online before studying case evidence.
Use source artifacts to separate facts from your diagnosis and recommendation.
Download Excel only when you need to work in a model, workbook or exercise.
Document the lead decision and the reasoning behind it.
Submit required case, incident, planning and capstone work through the app.
course_home.online_learning_statement: Read the teaching content online first. Download files primarily when you need to work in an exercise, workbook, planning model or submission template.
